## Summary
Calculates connection quality scores for SFU media streams from RTP delta statistics, receiver reports, packet loss, RTT, jitter, bitrate expectations, layer transitions, mute state, and pause state. The package also emits analytics stream statistics and maps internal scores to LiveKit connection quality and MOS values.

## Responsibilities
- Collect RTP delta stats from receiver-side or sender-side providers.
- Convert RTP stream and layer statistics into analytics payloads.
- Score media quality from packet loss, RTT, jitter, bitrate, and layer distance.
- Track mute, layer mute, pause, bitrate transition, and layer transition effects on scoring.
- Map internal scores to MOS and `livekit.ConnectionQuality`.
